text:
这是同一份 14 页中文路演 PPT 按独立审查意见修改后的版本。改动页：第 3 页第 4 条改为「0 依赖 / 手机可选」；第 4 页两处措辞收紧；第 6 页删掉对比度数字；第 8 页底部两行改为「缓存内只平移；越界才补边解码」；第 9 页第 3 步加「已验三城」；第 11 页 SD 复位改为「SD 卡硬复位（不是整机）」；第 12 页整页重做（原「工程账本」改为三栏：自研 / 基于 / 可复现 + 底部边界说明）；第 13 页第 05 条改写。

请完整逐页验收，重点：
- 第 12 页三栏是否平衡、文字是否溢出、底部两行是否压线；
- 第 8/9/11 页改后的长句是否越界或断行别扭；
- 第 3 页「0 依赖」大字是否与右侧设备冲突；
- 其余页是否受影响。

PNG：/home/jinsc/SDK/vela/ppt/.build/render3/s-01.png 到 s-14.png。

每页一行 JSON：{"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素与位置"],"fix":"一句可执行修法"}。最后一句总体判断。

thinking:
I'm the visual acceptance reviewer for a 14-page Chinese roadshow PPT. I need to review pages s-01.png to s-14.png in /home/jinsc/SDK/vela/ppt/.build/render3/.

The user (coordinator) asked for:
- Full page-by-page acceptance
- Focus points:
  - Page 12: three columns balanced, text overflow, bottom two lines pressing the line
  - Pages 8/9/11: whether the modified long sentences overflow or break awkwardly
  - Page 3: whether "0 依赖" big text conflicts with right device image
  - Other pages: whether affected
- Output format: one JSON line per page: {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素与位置"],"fix":"一句可执行修法"}
- Final sentence: overall judgment

Note the output format requested by the coordinator differs slightly from my system prompt format (issues as strings array with fix field). The coordinator's format takes priority for the dispatch: {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素与位置"],"fix":"一句可执行修法"}. I should follow the coordinator's requested format since they explicitly asked for it.

Let me read the images one by one. I'll start with the first batch.

text: 我将读取所有 14 页渲染图，逐页验收。先看第 1、2、3 页。

thinking:
Page 1: Cover slide. "Helm One" title, subtitle, device mockup on right showing speedometer at 20.5 km/h. Layout looks clean. Left side text, right side device. The caption "P02 · 表盘页 20.5 km/h" below device. Bottom footer items. Looks balanced. Pass.

Page 2: Problem slide. Three items 01 反光, 02 手套, 03 没网, right side big statement "码表的第一性原理：抬头 0.5 秒，看清一个数。" Clean. Page number 02/14. Pass.

Page 3: Product slide "四个不肯妥协的选择". Four rows: 2.4" 半透半反, 2 颗 无触摸按键, 3 km 离线网格, 0 依赖 手机可选. The "0 依赖" big text — check whether it conflicts with the right device. The text block extends to about x=1180 (the description text "不装 App 也能记录、导航、返航；App 只做画线、通知和 OTA。" ends around x=1180). The device is at x~1500-1900. No overlap. The "0 依赖" big text is at x~110-290. Fine. The right side device P01 · 地图首页, and below "240×320 · 半透半反 · 无触摸". Looks fine. Pass.

Now pages 4, 5, 6.

text: 第 1–3 页已读。第 3 页「0 依赖」文字区在 x≈1180 内结束，与右侧设备（x≈1500 起）无冲突。继续读第 4、5、6 页。

thinking:
Page 4: 整机 slide. Left: three cards 感知/计算/呈现, right column: 屏选半透半反 / 不做触摸 / 图放 SD / 双核分工 / 车上独立. Clean, no overflow. The change on page 4 was "两处措辞收紧" — I can't verify what exactly but nothing looks broken. Pass.

Page 5: 架构 slide. Stacked rows APP/LINK/HELM/BSP/OS/SoC, right column 19 / 6 / A2.0. Clean. Pass.

Page 6: 图形 slide. Three device mockups P05 仪表台, P03 全数字, P07 菜单. Third mockup (P07 菜单) appears cropped at the bottom — the menu list shows "导航 / 蓝牙设备 / 工具箱" and there's a partially visible item at the bottom edge (looks like "界面" partially cut). Hmm, is that destructive cropping? Let me look closer. The third mockup shows a menu with items: 导航 (blue highlighted), then 设备 section: 蓝牙设备, 工具箱, then 系统 section with a partially visible item cut at the bottom edge of the phone frame. Actually the phone frame itself ends there — the mockup is a device screenshot that is cut off at the bottom by the frame edge. This could be intentional (mockup showing a scrolling menu, cropped naturally) or a rendering issue.

Looking at the image: the third device mockup (P07 菜单) has visible content cut at its bottom border — a row labeled "界面" (or something) is half-visible. Since the mockup is framed as a device with rounded corners, the content being clipped mid-row inside the frame looks like the screenshot itself is taller than the frame, or the menu page naturally has content below the fold. Hmm. Actually for a device screenshot mockup, the entire screen should be shown within the frame. The bottom shows a partial row which suggests the screenshot was cropped to fit. Is this "destructive cropping"? It's inside the image. The row is partially cut by the bottom edge of the device screen — that's actually realistic for a menu that scrolls (the screen shows the top of the menu; a partially visible item at the bottom edge is normal in real UI screenshots, indicating scrollability). Real phone screenshots commonly show a partially cut list item at the bottom. So this is acceptable/realistic, not a defect.

Also check page 6: the status bar strip "19:40 ..." below the mockups with caption 状态栏五态. And "同一份 LVGL 源码，PC 模拟器逐页渲染。" The change: "第 6 页删掉对比度数字" — the 半透半反 section now says "文字只用墨色；颜色只承载形状，不承载信息" — no contrast numbers. Good.

Layout: three mockups at top left, captions below each. Status bar strip below. Right column with 4 sections. Looks balanced. The third mockup's bottom is slightly cut mid-row but that's within the mockup. I'll consider it pass. Actually wait — let me zoom into page 6's third mockup to be sure. The bottom of the third phone shows "系统" label then a partial row. Given rounded-corner phone frame, the content ends at frame. Fine.

Pass for 4, 5, 6.

Now pages 7, 8, 9.

text: 第 4–6 页正常：第 6 页「半透半反」栏已无对比度数字；第三台设备（P07 菜单）底边半行列表项属真实滚动截屏样式，非破坏性裁切。继续读第 7、8、9 页。

thinking:
Page 7: 性能 slide. Four bars with before→after values and percentage changes. Bars, labels all clean. Bottom footnotes ①②③ and source line. Layout fine. Note the bar lengths: 地图瓦片光栅化 27.2→21.9, bar shows dark portion ~ 2/3; 滚动补边 61.0→43.7 dark ~ 70%; PSRAM 2.88→1.94 dark ~67%; 导航投影 195→17, dark tiny ~9%. Bars represent relative values normalized per item ("相对值为各项自身改前归一"), so dark bar = after relative to before. 21.9/27.2 = 0.805 → dark should be ~80% of full width? Actually the dark portion appears ~ 571-1100 of 531-1237... let me estimate: full bar spans x≈531 to 1237 (706 px). Dark portion for first bar spans 531→1100 = 569 px ≈ 80.6%. 21.9/27.2 = 80.5%. Correct. Second: dark 531→1040 = 509/706 = 72%; 43.7/61 = 71.6%. Correct. Third: dark 531→1012 = 481/706 = 68%; 1.94/2.88 = 67.4%. Correct. Fourth: dark 531→593 = 62/706 = 8.8%; 17/195 = 8.7%. Correct. Great, bars are accurate. Pass.

Page 8: 地图 slide. Change: bottom two lines now "缓存内只平移；越界才补边解码 ·20 ms 泵 / 2 块 / 8 ms 预算". The bottom two lines: "3 km 网格 ·256×256 矢量瓦片 ·z14" and "缓存内只平移；越界才补边解码 ·20 ms 泵 / 2 块 / 8 ms 预算". Both fit on one line each, no overflow, don't cross the bottom margin (page number 08/14 sits below at right). The long line ends around x≈1580, within margins. Line breaks look fine. The map image on left is clean, caption below "P04 · 地图页局部：真机矢量底图". Pass.

Page 9: 导航 slide. Step 3 now "全国路网（已验三城） / 沿轨迹；只导不记也". Wait — look carefully: "全国路网（已验三城） / 沿轨迹；只导不记也行". The text in the image reads "全国路网（已验三城） / 沿" then "轨迹；只导不记也行" on the second line. Hmm, "沿轨迹" is broken across lines: "沿" at end of line 1, "轨迹" starting line 2. Is that awkward? Chinese text wraps character by character normally; breaking "沿轨迹" between 沿 and 轨 is acceptable in Chinese typesetting (no strict word-boundary rule). But the coordinator specifically asked: "第 8/9/11 页改后的长句是否越界或断行别扭". Let me examine.

Step 3 text: "全国路网（已验三城） / 沿轨迹；只导不记也行" — rendered as two lines:
Line 1: "全国路网（已验三城） / 沿"
Line 2: "轨迹；只导不记也行"

Breaking "沿/轨迹" mid-word is slightly awkward but common in CJK wrapping. Hmm. Is it "断行别扭"? The phrase "沿轨迹" split as "沿 | 轨迹" — Chinese line breaking doesn't respect word boundaries typically; it's normal. But there is a space before "沿" ("沿轨迹" preceded by " / "), and the break happens right after "沿". Slightly awkward but standard.

Also check other columns for line breaks:
Step 1: "点途经点自动吸路，或直接 / 画 / 导入 GPX" — "直接" ends line 1, "画 / 导入 GPX" line 2. Breaking "直接画" between 直接 and 画 — fine.
Step 2: "蓝牙写 import/，或 USB / MTP 拷入" — "USB" ends line 1, "MTP 拷入" line 2. Fine.
Step 4: "转向横幅；偏航 35 m 自 / 动重规划" — "自/动" split across lines! "自动重规划" broken as "自" end of line 1, "动重规划" line 2. That's a mid-word break of "自动". Again, CJK wrapping normally allows this, but is it awkward? "自 / 动重规划" — it's typographically acceptable in Chinese (Chinese wraps at any character). I shouldn't fail a slide for standard CJK wrapping. The coordinator asks whether 长句 "越界或断行别扭" — the breaks are within standard CJK behavior, no overflow beyond columns. Let me check whether any text exceeds its column. Step 3 line 1: "全国路网（已验三城） / 沿" ends around x≈1120; step 4 column starts around x≈1180. No overlap. Fine.

Step 5: "到达 45 m； 把记录反向即 / 返航" — "即/返航" break. Fine.

Bottom statement: "导航和记录是两件事：可以只导不记，也可以边导边记。" plus sub-line. Fine.

Large empty middle area between step descriptions and the bottom divider — the content occupies top ~45% and bottom ~25%, with a large empty band in the middle. Is that "visible imbalance"? The slide is a 5-step flow at top plus a takeaway at bottom. The vertical gap between steps (ending y≈530) and the divider (y≈820) is about 290px of empty space. Hmm, for a presentation slide this is breathing room, though somewhat large. It's a design choice — flow diagram top, conclusion bottom. I'd not fail this; it doesn't read as unfinished; it reads as intentional whitespace. Borderline but pass.

Now pages 10, 11, 12.

text: 第 7–9 页已读。第 8 页底部两行均在边距内、各占一行未折行；第 9 页第 3 步已含「已验三城」，各行断行属中文常规逐字换行、未越列。继续读第 10、11、12 页。

thinking:
Page 10: App slide. Left column: 手机 App · FLUTTER, items 规划/通知/星历/传输/升级 with a "骑行 · 设备 · 设置" pill. Right column: 码表 · 不依赖手机, items 记录/导航/显示/设置. Bottom: "没有账号，没有云： App 只做码表做不了的事。" and right "Flutter 3 · 三栏 · 中英双语". Clean, balanced. Pass.

Page 11: 可靠性 slide (dark background). Big "0" on left with "次看门狗复位" and "单次开机 31,965 s （8.9 h）". Right three sections. The third section: "SD 连续 3 次失败 → SD 卡硬复位（不是整机）； GNSS 僵尸栈槽回收； 4 类故障 × 5 轮注入全部恢复。" This fits on one line, ends around x≈1880, within the right margin (page width 1999, margin ~1890?). Let me check: the line ends at "。" around x=1878. The top section line 1 ends "不从 SysTick 喂。" around x=1880. The divider lines extend to ~1885. So it fits, roughly aligned. Fine.

Left side: big red "0" centered vertically around y=380-710, with caption below. Left column has a lot of empty dark space below caption (y=850 to bottom). But that mirrors design of the deck (big number + short caption). Balance: left has the giant 0 as visual anchor; acceptable.

Bottom source line at y≈1030: "31,965 s 单 boot: clip 0 / stop feed 0 / DVFS 恢复 0 / BT RX 停顿 0。来源: docs/watchdog_irq_priority.md". Fits. Pass.

Page 12: 开源 slide (redone). Three columns 自研 / 基于 / 可复现:
- 自研: "板级 · 骑行应用 · Flutter App · 地图工具链" (two lines)
- 基于: "openvela · NuttX · LVGL · OpenStreetMap （ODbL）" (two lines)
- 可复现: "模拟器跑真 UI · 29 个演示场景 · 构建约 10 分钟" (two lines)

Column balance: all three have 2 lines of content. The text occupies y≈400-500. Below is a huge empty area (y≈500-780) until the divider at y≈780, then bottom text lines at y≈840 and y≈940. 

Hmm, the coordinator asked: 第 12 页三栏是否平衡、文字是否溢出、底部两行是否压线。

Three columns: column headers at same y, content two lines each. Balanced horizontally. Column widths: col1 x≈110-640, col2 x≈710-1240, col3 x≈1310-1840. Equal. Good.

Text overflow: none. All lines fit within columns.

底部两行是否压线: The bottom two lines: "自研部分 Apache-2.0；地图数据按 ODbL 署名；上游改动随仓库提交，不宣称已合入。" at y≈840, and "演示场景对应 7 步全流程，一条命令复跑；模拟器与板端同一份 LVGL 源码。" at y≈940. The page number "12 / 14" at y≈1065 bottom right. Do the two lines "压线" (press against the divider/bottom edge)? The divider is at y≈780, first line at ~840 — comfortable spacing. Second line at ~940, page bottom ~1125. Fine, no crowding against the edge.

However — vertical balance: the middle band between the column content (ends ~y=500) and the divider (y=780) is ~280px empty. The overall slide is sparse: top title, three short columns, divider, two lines. It reads as intentionally minimal, consistent with deck style (page 2, 9 also have whitespace). But is the slide "half empty"? The content: title ~y130-200, columns y280-500, then a gap to y780 divider, bottom notes to y960. Total used spans the page with a gap in the middle-lower area. Comparable to other slides' use of whitespace. I'd call it acceptable — though the gap between columns content and the divider is large. Compare page 9 which also has a large gap. The deck's style seems airy. Not a defect per se. Pass.

One thing to double check on page 12: the three columns' content lines — col 1 line 1 "板级 · 骑行应用 ·" ends with a trailing "·" then wraps to "Flutter App · 地图工具链". Similar in col 2: "openvela · NuttX · LVGL ·" wraps to "OpenStreetMap （ODbL）". Col 3: "模拟器跑真 UI ·" wraps to "29 个演示场景 · 构建约 10 分钟". The trailing "·" at end of wrapped line is a bit awkward (separator dangling at line end), but it mirrors deliberate list formatting where "·" separates items and the wrap happens to fall after a separator. Not a defect worth failing; it's consistent across all three columns.

Now pages 13, 14.

text: 第 10–12 页已读。第 11 页「SD 卡硬复位（不是整机）」整句单行、未越右边距；第 12 页三栏等宽、各两行，底部两行与分隔线及页底均有间距、未压线。继续读第 13、14 页。

thinking:
Page 13: 回馈 slide. Item 05 看门狗 now reads "关键任务持续有进展才喂狗；失去进展就停喂，等待复位" — single line, ends around x≈1870, within margin. Other items fine. Left statement block. Bottom note. Pass.

Page 14: closing slide. Title "让 openvela 从手腕，走到车把。" device mockup on right (boot screen with logo, "Helm One"), caption "开机 · 启动页 → 地图首页". "90 秒现场", "手机画线 → 车上导航 → 记录分享", bottom "源码 / 板级 / App / 地图工具链 · 全部随作品提交". Page number 14/14. Clean. Pass.

Now, wait — the coordinator's change list said "第 11 页 SD 复位改为「SD 卡硬复位（不是整机）」" — that's on rendered page 11 (s-11.png), the dark 可靠性 slide, which shows "SD 连续 3 次失败 → SD 卡硬复位（不是整机）". Confirmed present and fits on one line.

Also "第 9 页第 3 步加「已验三城」" — s-09 shows step 3 "全国路网（已验三城）". Confirmed.

"第 8 页底部两行改为「缓存内只平移；越界才补边解码」" — s-08 bottom line reads "缓存内只平移；越界才补边解码 ·20 ms 泵 / 2 块 / 8 ms 预算". Confirmed, one line, no overflow.

"第 3 页第 4 条改为「0 依赖 / 手机可选」" — s-03 row 4: "0 依赖 手机可选". Confirmed; no conflict with right device.

"第 4 页两处措辞收紧" — s-04 texts look fine, no overflow. Can't compare with previous version but nothing broken.

"第 6 页删掉对比度数字" — s-06 半透半反 section: "文字只用墨色；颜色只承载形状，不承载信息" — no contrast ratio numbers. Confirmed.

"第 12 页整页重做（三栏 自研/基于/可复现 + 底部边界说明）" — confirmed, balanced.

"第 13 页第 05 条改写" — confirmed single line.

Now final check on the focus items:

Page 12 three columns: balanced (equal width, equal 2-line content), no overflow, bottom two lines not pressing the line (divider at ~y780, line1 at ~y840, line2 at ~y940, page number ~y1065; bottom margin fine).

One consideration on page 12: large empty band between column content and divider (roughly 280px vertical). Is that a defect under "one card half empty"? The three columns each hold 2 lines — the columns are short but consistent; the whitespace is uniform, matches deck's airy style (cf. page 9, page 13 left column). Not failing.

Page 9: the coordinator asked about "断行别扭". Step 3: "全国路网（已验三城） / 沿轨迹；只导不记也行" wraps as "…/ 沿" | "轨迹；…". Breaking after "沿" separates the verb from its object "轨迹" — hmm, actually "沿轨迹" = along the track. Line 1 ends "沿", line 2 starts "轨迹". Also step 4 breaks "自" | "动重规划". These are standard CJK character wraps. In Chinese typesetting, breaking anywhere is acceptable; these aren't errors. Given "one glance at presentation distance", the text reads fine. Not failing. Should I mention as a minor note? The reporting rules: report an issue only when I can state the concrete problem. Character-level wrapping in Chinese is normal; I won't flag it.

Page 11: the third line "SD 连续 3 次失败 → SD 卡硬复位（不是整机）； GNSS 僵尸栈槽回收； 4 类故障 × 5 轮注入全部恢复。" — single line, long (~78 chars). At presentation distance this is one long line; but the deck uses consistent body sizes; it fits margins and doesn't wrap awkwardly. Fine.

Page 3: "0 依赖" big text at left column x≈110-290, description extends to x≈1180 max; device starts x≈1500. No conflict. The row 4 description "不装 App 也能记录、导航、返航； App 只做画线、通知和 OTA。" ends x≈1180, fine.

Cross-slide consistency: page numbers present on pages 2-14 (02/14 ... 14/14); cover has no page number (normal). Header labels consistent. Dark slides (1, 11, 14) vs light slides — intentional alternation (cover, reliability highlight, closing). Palette consistent.

All 14 pages pass. Let me compose the output in the requested format: one JSON line per page with "issues" and "fix". For pass pages, issues empty array and fix maybe "" or null? The coordinator's format: {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素与位置"],"fix":"一句可执行修法"}。 For passing pages, I'll give issues: [] and fix: "". Then final sentence overall judgment.
